duration_analysis.title: Construction Duration Analysis
duration_analysis.intro: The 48–50 month construction timeline for Serro warrants close examination. This duration is significantly longer than Emaar's typical villa project delivery, which averages 30–36 months from launch to handover.

factors.label: Master Infrastructure Integration
factors.detail: Serro sits within The Heights' 81 million sq.ft masterplan, which requires concurrent development of roads, utilities, wellness facilities, and landscaping before residential handovers can commence.

factors.label: Phased Community Development
factors.detail: The broader Dubai South ecosystem—including schools, retail, and public amenities—is being developed in phases, directly impacting Serro's construction and handover timeline.

factors.label: Scale of Amenities
factors.detail: The wellness lake, 38km of cycling tracks, and country club facilities require extended construction periods that precede villa handovers.

milestones.label: Launch & bookings open
milestones.detail: Booking open for both Serro and Serro 2. Site preparation and foundation piling underway. Infrastructure corridors and utility connections are the initial focus.

milestones.label: Site preparation & earthworks
milestones.detail: Earthworks, utility trenching, and road base preparation underway. Central wellness amenities being prioritised to ensure they are operational near first handovers.

milestones.label: Vertical construction & amenities
milestones.detail: Villa vertical construction begins in earnest. Schools, retail nodes, and wellness lake scheduled for progressive completion. 38km cycling and jogging network connected across Serro clusters.

milestones.label: Serro — official handover
milestones.detail: Planned handover for Serro (Cluster 1). Snagging inspections and possession transfers begin. 383 units delivered across the handover window.

milestones.label: Serro 2 — official handover
milestones.detail: Planned handover for Serro 2 (Cluster 2), approximately one quarter after Cluster 1. Community fully delivered.

on_ground.title: On-Ground Intelligence (February 2026)
on_ground.quote: Brokers familiar with the site report that early construction works have commenced, with site preparation and foundation piling underway as of February 2026. The initial focus is on infrastructure corridors and utility connections before vertical construction begins in earnest. Market sources indicate that Emaar is prioritizing the central wellness amenities to ensure they are operational near first handovers.
on_ground.verification: Information based on site visits and market sources. Construction progress should be independently verified via the Dubai REST app, which provides official milestone updates from RERA-registered projects.
